name: task-edge-target-absent-drift-prune
body: finalize_graph drops a task edge whose target FQN is absent from the branch graph: a creates/target edge to an FQN not declared as a planned node is pruned, the same drift policy as implemented-by. Limit: the plan surface cannot deliberately name an undeclared planned destination. Upgrade if that surface starts naming undeclared planned destinations: add explicit admission rather than the silent prune.
